versions.changelog:
- No file changes detected; metadata update only.
- Version incremented to 1.0.2.
- No functional or documentation changes in this release.

- Improved documentation and prerequisites in SKILL.md for better environment setup and guidance.
- Added explicit bash command example to run environment checks.
- Clarified dependency installation and usage of skill-quality-cli.
- Removed outdated or redundant documentation file (skill-card.md).
- Minor formatting and doc structure adjustments for clarity.

- Initial release of Huawei Cloud IAM Diagnose skill.
- Provides reference permission analysis for IAM users, including permission chain tracing, group/agency evaluation, and policy parsing.
- Outputs a "likely has / likely has not" verdict with confidence grading and chain trace.
- Supports both system and custom policies, group inheritance, and agency stacking.
- All commands are strictly read-only and must be executed through skill-quality-cli for quality telemetry.
- Results are not authoritative—custom/complex policy scenarios are flagged "for reference only."
